Input 1 is exact identity reference. Input 2 is exact WEST-facing camera/body proportion baseline. Input 3 is approved hand-painted style reference only; do not reproduce its UI.

All action through actual shoulders, elbows, hips, knees and ankles; no duplicate limbs or floating hands.
Action frame HIT W03 of 06, maximum recoil after an invisible blow FROM screen left. Both daggers retained. Scarf lags leftward from recoil without covering hands. Make a readable recoil, not an attack, no blood or effects.
